description: This file contains an immutable implementation of the FilteredTopic interface, providing functionality to parse, build, and represent filtered topic strings with query parameters, namespaces, filters, and extra fields in the Eclipse Ditto connectivity model.

classes.name: ImmutableFilteredTopic
classes.description: Immutable implementation of FilteredTopic that provides methods to parse, compare, and generate string representations of filtered topics, including query parameters, namespaces, filters, and extra fields.

classes.name: ImmutableFilteredTopic.ImmutableFilteredTopicBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for creating instances of ImmutableFilteredTopic with configurable properties.

classes.name: ImmutableFilteredTopic.FilteredTopicStringParser
classes.description: Private helper class to parse filtered topic strings into ImmutableFilteredTopic instances.

methods.name: getBuilder
methods.description: Returns a builder to create an ImmutableFilteredTopic for a given topic.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableFilteredTopic instance from its string representation.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Returns the topic component of the filtered topic.

methods.name: getNamespaces
methods.description: Returns the list of namespaces associated with the filtered topic.

methods.name: getExtraFields
methods.description: Returns the optional extra fields selector.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the string representation.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Returns the character at a specified position in the string representation.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence of the string representation.
